title: Workflow Definition Descriptor
description: The meta-schema of the Workflow Definition Descriptor (WDD): the versioned, structured definition file the ballerina/workflow compiler plugin generates at build time and packs into the integration's executable JAR as the fixed-name resource 'workflow.def.json'. The descriptor captures only structural facts — what registers with the workflow runtime, plus JSON Schemas — never expression-valued instance parameters (roles, titles, retry counts, timeouts, payloads).

descriptorVersion.description: WDD spec version (major.minor). Minor versions are additive-only; consumers must not parse an unknown major.

package.description: The Ballerina package this descriptor describes.

checksum.description: SHA-256 of the document's canonical bytes (sorted keys, no insignificant whitespace) serialized without this field. Instance identity is (package.org, package.name, package.version, checksum).

workflows.description: Every @workflow:Workflow function in the package, sorted by name.

agents.description: Every module-level durable-agent declaration's static structure, sorted by name.

name.description: The registered workflow type (the function name, without the runtime's 'workflow-' prefix).

input.description: The workflow's start input as a single form: one property per data parameter. The slot's type is the parenthesized data-parameter list.
The activity's data parameters as a single form; also backs review 'proceed-with-input' forms.

output.description: The activity's return. The slot type records the full (possibly error-bearing) type; the schema describes the success members only.

name.description: The task name as written at the awaitHumanTask call site; qualified at runtime as <workflow>.<task>.

reviewActivities.description: Which activities are human-reviewed, and on which trigger. The review's proceed-with-input form is the activity's input slot — not repeated here.

name.description: The agent's stable identity: its module-level variable name.

tools.description: Declared capabilities advertised to the model. Runtime-added capabilities surface through runtime APIs only, never the descriptor.

functionRef.description: The implementation binding: the module-level function the runtime resolves and invokes for this structure. Structural — it is what registers with the runtime.

module.description: Qualified module name: <org>/<module> (the module name includes submodule parts, e.g. acme/procurement.ledger).

version.description: The module's major version — the granularity the runtime resolves symbols at.

typedSlot.description: A typed schema slot. The resolved Ballerina type descriptor is always recorded; the JSON Schema is a derived rendering emitted per representability tier: exact for closed anydata shapes, permissive + lossy for open anydata (json, anydata), omitted for the unrepresentable (xml, error, behavioral types, and composites mixing them into JSON data).

type.description: The resolved Ballerina type descriptor — the source of truth. For parameter-list inputs this is the parenthesized data-parameter list.

lossy.description: Present (true) when the schema is a permissive approximation of the type rather than an exact rendering — form generators should not over-promise validation.

schemaDocument.description: The pinned JSON Schema dialect: the exact 2020-12 subset the workflow runtime's TypesUtil emits. Extensions to this subset arrive only with WDD minor versions.
